script_text: Have you felt your animal guide growing restless? Spirit Animals channel the Moon's intuitive power through Water's emotional depths. With Neptune in your 12th House trining Jupiter in your 8th House, psychic sensitivity spikes — expect vivid dreams guiding love decisions and career moves. Romance beckons through unexpected spiritual connections, while money opportunities emerge from hidden inheritances or shared resources. The shadow warns of confusion between intuition and illusion; your North Node in Taurus demands grounding. Chiron's retrograde urges you to heal ancestral wounds through animal symbolism. Light sage and meditate with your spirit ally daily. Comment your sign below and share which animal has been visiting your dreams.
